title: Moon Dust document: fireball and silent aircraft at a Bolivian crash site

tellings.quote: Another details a fireball and subsequent sightings of silent aircraft near a Bolivian crash site.

plain: A declassified document from Moon Dust, a programme Michels presents as part of US efforts to recover crashed objects, describes a fireball and then sightings of silent aircraft near a crash site in Bolivia. Michels cites it himself, in an episode on whether Henry Kissinger oversaw a UFO crash retrieval programme, as evidence that such recoveries were real.
